summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests nirogacestat, a drug taken by mouth, in adults with desmoid tumors (also called aggressive fibromatosis). Participants take nirogacestat every day in each 28-day cycle, either once a day or twice a day about 12 hours apart, depending on when they enroll. The record does not state a main outcome; it says the study aims to learn about the safety and effects of the drug.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 prueba nirogacestat, un medicamento que se toma por vía oral, en adultos con tumores desmoides (también llamados fibromatosis agresiva). Los participantes toman nirogacestat todos los días durante cada ciclo de 28 días, una vez al día o dos veces al día con unas 12 horas de diferencia, según la fecha de inscripción. El registro no indica el resultado principal; describe el objetivo del estudio como conocer la seguridad y los efectos del medicamento.
who_for: Desmoid tumor confirmed by tissue exam, with tumor growth on imaging within the past 18 months.
New or previously treated disease; prior treatment must have stopped at least 28 days earlier.
ECOG performance status of 2 or better.
Adequate blood, liver and kidney test results, and able to swallow tablets.
not_for: Known allergy to nirogacestat or its ingredients.
Unable to have repeated biopsies or MRI scans.
Brain metastases or another cancer that could interfere with the study.
